option.approach: Separate the independently justified existence and exclusion results. Determine what can actually be concluded about the set of dimensions without treating an unverified compactness statement as an input.

judge.reason: It claims an exact set of dimensions, mathematically identical to e3.

options.counterfactual: An admissible blow-up sequence exists in some dimension below 19, despite positivity of all the polynomial boundary-jet forms examined so far. Such a sequence uses a concentration mechanism not captured by the single-bubble polynomial model.
options.approach: Investigate multiple interacting bubbles and sequences with unbounded energy. Check whether their interaction terms can balance the positive local dilation obstruction without yielding an isolated simple blow-up.
